scope: Nine third-batch business families, all 36 configurations, 320px structural states and dedicated real DOM workflows; cross-batch links are tested separately.

checks.name: All nine empty public families and 36 independent configurations mount without caller mutation
Every third-batch scenario and seven content states fit a 320px container
Primary-goal switching is atomic, acknowledged and leaves linked plans unchanged
Goals are created from an empty directory through ordinary forms
Goal archive requires a reason, preserves history and restores as a backup
Plan task creation, ordering and activation use the configured goal and task directories
Plan task completion requires evidence and never silently completes the plan
Plan pause, reasoned schedule changes and stale goal references have distinct behavior
Jobs show real salary and vacancy states and only create pinned application drafts
Job collections are idempotent and rejected writes retain the current selection
Unknown salary, zero vacancies, expired jobs and private drafts are not conflated
Job author creates, edits, publishes and closes a real record
Application submission rejects changed resume versions and preserves the old draft snapshot
Application submission, stage recording and terminal states wait for explicit acknowledgement
Offer acceptance is a personal recorded intention and other students stay absent from the DOM
Indicator zero and boolean false survive explicit submission snapshots
Indicator source, range, evidence and closed periods produce actionable errors
Indicator designer assigns real owners and prevents mismatched responsibility units
Indicator return preserves submitted versions and self-review is forbidden by default
Evidence uses real File objects and rejected submission preserves editable evidence
Evidence version submit snapshots, reviewer return, and next-version creation keep history
Evidence approval and withdrawal have separate permissions and states
Evidence ordinary creation supports link/data types and unsafe URLs cannot be submitted
Evidence readonly mode still switches historical versions without mutating stored records
Equipment, tools and training-room inventory can be created and edited from actual forms
Loan requests enforce valid time windows and do not reserve stock before approval
Loan approval checks repair blocks, capacity conflicts and premature checkout
Returning damaged equipment remains occupied until inspection and then marks maintenance
Active borrowed records protect capacity edits and retiring cannot orphan loans
Borrower DOM excludes other people but retains anonymous occupancy for conflict checks
Repair report creation, real attachments and assignment are independently acknowledged
Repair assignment validates active technicians and starts only after acceptance
Repair worker records zero minutes, waits for materials and submits results without closing
Reporter acceptance and failed acceptance preserve repair histories and never auto-release inventory
Admissions authorization blocks phone/message records while internal notes remain operable
Admissions appointments require a future follow-up and stages cannot be skipped accidentally
Admissions stage changes require evidence and enrolled records cannot silently regress
Duplicate leads merge conservatively without erasing histories or restoring withdrawn contact authorization
Admissions creation and assignment use configurable source/program/owner directories
All nine readonly/disabled families prevent business mutation while retaining permitted browsing
Cancellation, duplicate prevention and request IDs protect pending third-batch operations
Directory updates cancel stale acknowledgements and preserve modal drafts for revalidation
Loader failures preserve drafts and late loads cannot replace fresh configurations
Chinese composition does not submit an old indicator narrative and reset restores acknowledged draft values
Forbidden and destroyed components remove rendered private data and abort owned requests/dialogs
